chunks: The narration of al-Kāhilī and Ḥusayn ibn al-Mukhtār from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام.
He said: “What is meant by that is four mithqāls.”

key_terms.الْقَصْدُ: the intended meaning or intended measure

ai.seo_question: What amount is intended by the phrase mentioned in this narration from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith reports from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام a clarification of an intended measure, stating that it is four mithqāls. In its chapter context, it relates to juridical details concerning the rites and procedures connected to a person at the time of death.
